Putting it on your Choosatron

  • From your Choosatron: open its web interface, go to the Catalog tab and find this story there.
  • From this page: download an edition, then open your Choosatron's Stories tab and drop the file on Drop a story file here. This works even when your Choosatron has no internet connection.

This site can't install stories by itself: a web page here isn't allowed to reach a device on your home network.
